limitations: Only ordinary geometric quotients for complete graphs; wedge is homotopy, not homeomorphism. No integral equivariant lattice or Borel classification. 1997 original preprint and Pfeifle full text could not be inspected; publication-priority risk.
scientific_integrity: Uniform proof using explicit quotient cells, integral chain differential, and classical Armstrong and Hom-complex theorems; finite checks independently corroborate bounded cases. Previous rational quotient formula credited; no independent review claimed.
title: Alternating-color quotients of complete-graph Hom complexes are integral sphere wedges
